responsibility: This header declares the string-based argument parsing API in the mc-boot runtime. It defines the public procedures that parse a command-line text buffer into positional arguments and count them, distinguishing this interface from the separate process-argv access modules such as Args and SArgs.
same_name_distinction: Declaration half of the CmdArgs pair: unlike GCmdArgs.cc, it does not parse strings itself and only publishes the string-tokenization entry points.
